description: Open local specs and sign in through the browser. Outbound HTTP is our own reqwest command, not the http plugin — see src/http.rs.

permissions.comment: Sign-in hands {appUrl}/cli-auth to the default browser. Listed as a bare permission this allows nothing — the scope has to be explicit, which is what produced 'Not allowed to open url'. Kept host-wide because appUrl is configurable (stage, self-hosted), and handing a URL to the user's own browser is a low-risk operation the user initiated.
